983-2026-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr doesn't have summoning sickness.
983-2026-2645-3430.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
983-2026-2645-3430.description:
Activate Temple of the False God by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Temple of the False God
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2169-2921-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-2921-4694-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat from step 2.

640-1981-2415-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3129-5478-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
3129-5478-6753-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

3581-5078-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Kykar.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat

1395-5078-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

2092-2757-5140-6298.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Linvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Linvala, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Linvala by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3259-4885-7262.easyPrerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
3259-4885-7262.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4885-7262.description:
Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
3259-4885-7262.notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

4067-5527-6281-7206.easyPrerequisites: You control two or more creatures.
4067-5527-6281-7206.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
4067-5527-6281-7206.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Dundoolin Weaver.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Dundoolin Weaver that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Dundoolin Weaver token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dundoolin Weaver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat.

Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

104-4659-5086-5183-6753.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-4659-5086-5183-6753.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

930-5256-6871-6879.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Universal Automaton.
When Universal Automaton dies, Haru triggers, returning Universal Automaton from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

826-4508-5880-6705.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Magmaw to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a 1/1 Frog creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

112-974.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability.
Holding priority, cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a lore counter from There and Back Again and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Resolve the There and Back Again ability, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, putting a lore counter from There and Back Again and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers. Holding priority, cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a lore counter from There and Back Again and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Resolve the There and Back Again ability, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token.
Put either Smaug into your graveyard due to the legend rule. The Smaug that dies triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate eight Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 4.
112-974.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can cast Clockspinning infinitely to trigger There and Back Again's first and/or second chapter abilities as many times as desired.

222-527-5147-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5147-6633.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Repeat.

Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

813-2104-3306.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating two Blood tokens.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Bloods, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-1339-6092.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.

Draw a card.

When the Insect enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Insect, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1652-4499-4605-5542.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Patron of the Arts.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers once, and Preston triggers twice.
Resolve the Patron of the Arts trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Patron of the Arts that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Patron of the Arts token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

When the Evangel of Heliod token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Evangel of Heliod token and the Soldier tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

539-1003-2232-2374.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
When Phyrexian Walker enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Ashaya, Maja triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
When the Human Warrior enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
